title: Viterbi Decoder
source_docs: Communications Toolbox HDL Support/Error Detection and Correction/Convolutional/Viterbi_Decoder.md
Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/Viterbi_Decoder.md
text: Decode convolutionally encoded data using Viterbi algorithm, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Decision type} sets Decoder decision type; {Trellis structure}, {numInputSymbols} sets the number, {numOutputSymbols} sets the number, {numStates} sets the number, {nextStates}, {outputs}, {Punctured code} sets the option, {Puncture vector} sets the puncture pattern 1; 0; 1; {Enable erasures input port} sets the option to enable erasures input port, {Number of soft decision bits} sets the soft input word length, {Error if quantized input values are out of range} sets the option to error if quantized input values are out, {Traceback depth}, {Operation mode} sets the termination method of encoded frame, {Enable reset input port} sets the option to add reset input port, {Delay reset action to next time step} sets the option to delay reset action until next time, {State metric word length} and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Era
ports.summary: Erasure bits in codeword binary-valued vector

params.name: Trellis structure
params.values: Trellis description of convolutional code poly2trellis(7,[171 133]) (default)

params.values: Number of symbols input to encoder 2 K

params.values: Number of symbols output from encoder 2 N

params.values: Number of states in encoder power of 2

params.values: Option to enable specification of code puncturing off (default) | on

params.values: Option to enable erasures input port off (default) | on
